function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the HyperFund and HyperVerse alleged cryptocurrency-fraud network comprehensively, using only sources and source IDs available through the benchmark tools and reporting those exact source IDs. Cover: (1) alleged business and compensation mechanics, including investor deposits, represented or promised returns, referral and recruitment incentives, withdrawal restrictions or failures, and evidence or allegations of Ponzi-like operation; (2) public promoters, endorsers, leaders, and affiliates, including their roles, public statements, marketing activities, and promotion channels; (3) the chronology and significance of the names HyperFund, HyperVerse, and any other names or rebrands that are directly supported by sources; (4) the purported CEO or leadership persona, including identity, biography, credentials, public presentation, and disputed or questionable aspects; (5) how the mechanics, promoters, branding, and leadership persona allegedly interacted to attract, persuade, and retain investors; and (6) contradictions, gaps, alternative interpretations, jurisdictional and temporal limits, and source-quality limitations. For every material point, clearly label whether it is an established fact, an allegation, an assessment/inference, or an uncertainty. Do not invent entity IDs, relationship names, facts, or sources. Return a structured evidence matrix with verbatim or tightly paraphrased source-supported claims, exact source IDs, entity IDs when available, and explain which evidence supports each requested part. Give special attention to distinguishing official allegations and court or regulator findings from journalism, self-promotional claims, and unresolved accusations."}
function.name: ConductResearch
